market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and choppy. Yields at 20-year highs create headwinds for equities, but intraday tech rallies on yield dips show resilience. Oil two-way risk around diesel ban and Saudi pipeline. Trump-Xi summit is the dominant catalyst. Expect range-bound equities with elevated VIX. Bond market remains the primary driver of cross-asset flows.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle and M&A activity support earnings growth. However, sustained high rates and consumer confidence weakness cap upside. Geopolitical normalization (Iran inspections, US-China trade) could unlock risk-on rotation. Crypto maturation and cybersecurity demand are structural tailwinds. Key risk: if Fed is forced into aggressive hikes, recession risk rises materially.
